scope: Final review of software source, saved simulation evidence, electrical prototype, Wokwi demo and release contents
limitations: All line timing, reliability, quality and cost inputs are assumed rather than physically measured.
PCB has not been manufactured, assembled or electrically measured.
Fuse 3D geometry is an original simplified dimensional envelope.
Wokwi demo is standalone and is not a full port of the S3 virtual-cell controller or an n8n-connected physical cell.
Mechanical fixture remains a concept, without manufacturing or structural qualification.
Original software v1.0.1 archive excludes electrical and Wokwi additions; these are separate deliverables.
assessment: Suitable as a documented multi-part simulation and engineering prototype project; not a validated industrial machine or a single end-to-end physical implementation.
